summary: DAY discovery worked the full 12-company Chief batch in parallel and kept universe-wide discovery fail-closed. Current machine discovery probes are fresh, but all cadence-due gating families were not independently cleared and FINRA remains partition-freshness only. One concrete discovery-data defect was found: NasdaqTrader trailer rows are entering discovery-pool as fake tickers and should be filtered before any challenger handling. Batch signals strengthen AI/space infrastructure demand but do not resolve company-specific concentration, dilution or execution gates.

materialFindings.detail: The current discovery pool contains entries whose ticker is 'FILE CREATION TIME: ...'. This is a directory trailer, not a security. It is machine-generated state contamination and must be filtered before downstream discovery/admission logic. BURU is a separate real outside-universe listing signal requiring relevance screening.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Harden other-listed/new-listing parsing so 'File Creation Time' trailer records can never enter discovery-pool; quarantine/remove existing fake trailer entries through normal canonical repair path after Chief verification.
